message.tnd.lore.ocean: “Where light abandons the deep, blue remains exposed.” — The mural points to the floors of deep oceans.
message.tnd.lore.lava: “Beneath the fire, only one stone skin separated us from red.” — Search the first solid layer below lava lakes.
message.tnd.lore.forest: “Green feeds on roots, never branches.” — Some forest trees hide a shard at their feet.
message.tnd.lore.fusion: “Three colours open the passage; a fourth awakens the machines.” — Repair consoles with resonant shards. A composite crystal can also bond a little Shardling.

message.tnd.aegis_existing: Absorption already protects you. The aegis saves its dust.
message.tnd.aegis_active: Aegis active: two temporary hearts for fifteen seconds.
message.tnd.lore.vault: Three couplings: blue, green, then red. One echo dust wakes each seal. Guardians mark their impact before striking: leave the circle or break their charge. Exits remain open. After the three trials, claim the heart in the nave. Do not mistake silence for a permanent shutdown. After claiming the treasure, hold echo dust and click the core (cost: two dust) to awaken the Custodian. Its fractures target the ground; its crown leaves a safe centre. Strike its core after each attack.
tooltip.tnd.inertial_matrix: Shared Custodian treasure. Builds a Resonance Forge.
tooltip.tnd.resonance_forge: 20 s + 1 dust: double raw metals or temper ancient alloy.
tooltip.tnd.forge_ports: Hoppers: input above, dust on the sides, output below.
tooltip.tnd.forge_pause: Redstone: pause. Hover ? in the forge for recipes.
tooltip.tnd.tempered_alloy: Forge: ancient alloy + 1 dust. Crafts and repairs tools.
message.tnd.custodian_hint: Hold echo dust and click the core (cost: 2).
message.tnd.custodian_fuel: Two echo dust are required. No fuel consumed.
message.tnd.custodian_empty: This sanctuary’s Custodian has already fallen. Its reward is shared by the party.
message.tnd.custodian_start: Evade the markings, then strike the exposed core.
message.tnd.custodian_ring: Crown: reach the centre or leave the outer circle!
message.tnd.custodian_open: The core is exposed: strike now!
message.tnd.custodian_phase: The crown fractures: two marked areas to evade!
message.tnd.custodian_victory: Custodian defeated! Claim the matrix from the core.
message.tnd.custodian_reward: Matrix and six alloys claimed. Craft the forge.
gui.tnd.forge.help: 20 s and 1 dust per cycle. Raw iron / copper / gold → 2 ingots. Ancient alloy → 1 tempered alloy. Hoppers: input above, dust on the sides, output below. Redstone: pause.
gui.tnd.forge.subtitle: 1 dust · 20 s / cycle
gui.tnd.forge.state.0: Insert raw metal or ancient alloy.
advancement.tnd.vestige.description: Travel through the portal to Vestige.
advancement.tnd.sanctuary.description: Claim the treasure of the three trials.
message.tnd.lore.observatory: “The sky is gone. We map its echoes.” — Survey six biomes, repair consoles and consult the desk. Anchors offer a return while their core remains intact.
tooltip.tnd.recall_prism: Bind to a Vestige anchor. Hold for 5 seconds.
tooltip.tnd.recall_cost: Cost: 2 dust. Cooldown: 60 s. Moving cancels.
tooltip.tnd.return_anchor: In Vestige: click while holding a prism to bind it.
tooltip.tnd.cartographer_trophy: Luminous trophy for completing eight expeditions.
message.tnd.recall_bind_help: In Vestige: hold a prism and click the anchor.
message.tnd.recall_bound: Prism bound. Hold 5 s to return (2 dust).
message.tnd.recall_dimension: The prism works only within Vestige.
message.tnd.recall_unbound: First bind the prism to a return anchor.
message.tnd.recall_fuel: Two echo dust are required in your inventory.
message.tnd.recall_missing: Anchor destroyed or replaced. Bind the prism again.
message.tnd.recall_arrived: Returned to the anchor. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
expedition.tnd.survey.description: Discover three different biomes in survival. Recorded biomes are checked.
expedition.tnd.atlas.description: Travel through all six Vestige biomes. Each biome counts once.
expedition.tnd.restoration.description: Repair three different Vestige consoles with resonant shards. Player-placed consoles do not count.
expedition.tnd.night_harvest.description: Harvest six mature echo aggregates at different positions during Vestige’s night.
expedition.tnd.sentinels.description: Defeat three Vestige sentinels. Trial guardians do not count.
expedition.tnd.observatory.description: Find an ancient observatory and use its survey desk. Crafted desks open expeditions but do not count as discoveries.
expedition.tnd.gear.description: Carry a resonant pickaxe or blade in survival. Tools from earlier versions also count.
expedition.tnd.cartographer.description: Complete and claim the seven other objectives to earn the luminous Cartographer Trophy.
